answer: Give each new identity a work-history gate: it must finish 20 requester-signed microtasks over at least 14 days, max 3 counting per day, while locking 100 POA for 21 days. A prism review splits each record into timing, funding and output signals, and auditors re-check a random 10%; two failed re-checks slash 40% of the lock and reset the history. Every extra fake therefore needs its own 100 POA, 20 tasks and two uncompressible weeks, and shared output patterns push linked accounts into a spiral of higher locks and deeper audits. Probation accounts carry an umber marker until cleared.
